summary: A continue targeting the same for...of loop continues iteration without IteratorClose.

tests.name: continue consumes next values
tests.input: let a=[]; for(const x of [1,2,3]){if(x<3)continue;a.push(x)} console.log(a);

tests.name: continue does not call return
tests.input: let r=0; const it={i:0,next(){return this.i<2?{value:++this.i,done:false}:{done:true}},return(){r++;return {done:true}},[Symbol.iterator](){return this}}; for(const x of it){continue} console.log(r);
